questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure identity, access, and security
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Zero Trust model
questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: Zero Trust: a security model that assumes breach and verifies each access request rather than trusting based on network location.
Verify explicitly: reassessing trust based on changing signals rather than assuming a one-time login establishes permanent trust.
Verify explicitly: using available signals such as identity, location, device, service, workload, and data classification to make access decisions.
Zero Trust: designing detection, segmentation, and response as though attackers may already be present.
Least-privilege access: using one identity sign-in to access multiple trusted applications.

questions.explanation: The correct pair is: Zero Trust — a security model that assumes breach and verifies each access request rather than trusting based on network location; and Verify explicitly — using available signals such as identity, location, device, service, workload, and data classification to make access decisions.
